extDescription.message: Own SQLite search index as a replacement for Gloda.

uiHint.message: The first run can take quite a while. Betterbird stays usable, but search is limited while indexing (NovaBird-Search uses Gloda meanwhile). You can pause and resume at any time.

rebuildWhyNewer.message: it comes from a newer NovaBird-DB version and cannot be read here

rebuildText.message:
The NovaBird-DB search index cannot be used: $WHY$.

Without the index, NovaBird-Search can only search through Gloda (slower, less accurate). Rebuild the index now? Depending on your mailbox this takes a few minutes; Betterbird stays usable. The old file is kept until the end and only deleted afterwards.

rebuildDeclinedTitle.message: The index will not be rebuilt

rebuildDeclinedText.message: Search speed and result quality are severely limited until the index is rebuilt. The rebuild is required for full functionality and must now be started manually in the NovaBird-DB settings ("Rebuild index"). NovaBird-DB will ask again at the next start.

optIndexingHint.message: Paused runs continue later where they stopped.

optLogHint.message: Shows what NovaBird-DB is doing right now (folders, numbers, reconciliation). Kept across restarts (last 400 lines).

optCompoundLabel.message: How should compound words be found?

optCompQueryText.message: For each search term NovaBird-DB looks in the index word list for longer words that contain it and whose prefix is itself a known word (“Speiseplan” → “Wochenspeiseplan”, but “meldung” does not match “Anmeldung”). No rebuild needed, learns from new mail automatically; the first search for a term can take a moment in very large mailboxes, afterwards it is cached.

optCompIndexText.message: While reading each mail, compound words are already split into their parts (from the word list of your own mailbox, without a dictionary) and stored in an extra index. Searching then needs no word list. When you switch, NovaBird-DB reads all mail again once (about 6–10 minutes for 75,000 mails, twice as long on a fresh install). Downside: a word is only split if both parts also occur often on their own in the mailbox; tests found fewer compounds than the default. Good for comparing.

optCompActiveIndex.message: Active: splitting at indexing time (seed list $1 words).

optConfirmCompound.message: Turn on splitting at indexing time? All mail is read again once for this (may take a few minutes; search uses Gloda meanwhile).

optSwitchedIndex.message: Switched. The index is being read again, see the overlay and log for progress.

optPrivacyText.message: The index contains the text of every mail (up to 100,000 characters) and the attachment names in plain text in the file novabird-db/index.sqlite in the Betterbird profile, like Betterbird's own index. It never leaves your computer. If you back up the profile folders or do not encrypt the disk, you also back up and expose the mail text. Encrypted mails (OpenPGP, S/MIME) are not indexed. “Delete index” removes the file completely.

optVersionText.message: NovaBird-DB and NovaBird-Search use experiment APIs. They only run in Betterbird and Thunderbird ESR (Extended Support Release), not in the regular Thunderbird release. We recommend the ESR versions, otherwise the add-ons do not work or not permanently.

optMaintHint.message: “Rebuild” puts the old index file aside, reads all mail again and only deletes the old file once the new index is complete. “Delete” removes the file until you rebuild or restart Betterbird. The mails themselves are never changed.

optConfirmReindex.message: Delete the index and read all mail again?

optReindexStarted.message: Rebuild started. You can follow the progress in the overlay.

optLoggingHint.message: Only queries you confirmed with Enter or ended with a hit are saved. Nothing leaves your computer. Later this shows which phrasings the parser should learn.

optLangsHint.message: Search queries are understood as sentences in these languages, e.g. “invoices from Jonas last week”. The default is the language of Betterbird. Several languages are meant for mixed mailboxes; short words with several meanings (such as “an” in German and in English) may then be misread. The short syntax (from:, to:, von:, an: …) always works.

optDebugHint.message: Also logs every page and slow messages (duration, subject). Turn on only for troubleshooting, it makes the log longer. If indexing stalls, the watchdog reports it even without this option. For problems, first repair the affected folder (right-click → Properties → Repair Folder).
